issue-4192: Export button stays greyed out after a failed export
Opened by ops-lukas on 2026-09-03

If an export fails (for example the server returns an error), the Export button
stays greyed out and I can't click it again until I reload the whole page.

args.title: Reset export button state after a failed export
args.body: File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx. In handleClick, the call to exportReport only sets busy back to false in the .then() success callback, so when the promise rejects (e.g. a non-2xx response throws), setBusy(false) never runs and the button stays disabled until a page reload. Add a .catch() (or try/finally) that resets busy to false and surfaces an error toast when the export fails.
